$Comment: Martha's Hunter: hand in Extra Turkeys, Martha's turkey quest with no limit
(Quests/SeasonsOfOrbis/_Harvest_Feast/Extra_Turkeys.json), several times, over as many feasts as it
takes. COMPLETE_QUEST counts each hand-in as its pay is collected. The description's number comes
from the criterion's Amount through @amount. Turkey Chaser (Turkey_Chaser.json) is the year's own
hunt; this one is the long one.
Earned once and kept: no Parent, so no yearly copy, and no full_table tag. Its gift waits in
Rewards.Claim on the achievements page: Harvest Coins, Wishbones for the Turkey Graveyard, and MMO
Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, Defense XP for the hunt. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the
hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the
rest still pays. The _Harvest_Feast folder makes the id harvest_feast_marthas_hunter, and its words
come from the keys that id spells.
